comment_regular: Reads four control-basis banks (2x2 traversal), each with an entry count. Each 0x34-byte entry contains a 1 x basisDimensions[bank] float matrix followed by a length-prefixed string. Reads coefficient floats, string length, then string bytes; any failed read returns false. Do not assume these banks are texture-only.
